issues.body: When a streaming response generator aborts midway due to client disconnection, the request context teardown callback may fire after the socket is already torn down, causing AsyncContextError.
issues.description: When a streaming response generator aborts midway due to client disconnection, the request context teardown callback may fire after the socket is already torn down, causing AsyncContextError.

Ensure generator.close() triggers clean context unwinding.
Benchmark streaming memory under high concurrency.

roadmap.problem_breakdown: Early client disconnection during HTTP streaming leaves ContextVar frames dangling in async execution loops.
